text:
Lina: Quick sync request — we're mapping out the marketplace cutover waves for upcoming GPU/accelerator launches (H100, H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi). Need to lock on embargo windows, marketplace image tags, and SI onboarding slots. Can partners + product signoff by EOD?

Tom: +1. Can we keep H100 and H200 in the same first wave but with separate image tags? avoids double maintenance.

Ravi: Agree on tags. Also need routing fallback mapping if a customer’s dedicated pool doesn't have H200 yet. Suggest policy: prefer newest-family -> compatible-quantized -> cpu-fallback.

Hannah: FYI legal asked for a 72hr pre-announce embargo window for joint press. That affects when marketplace listings can go live.

Carlos: Lab capacity: we have 3 H100 slots week of 4/12, 2 MI300 slots week of 4/26, Gaudi still behind vendor shipping ETA (mid-May). B200 can be inserted as burst capacity.

Lina: Good. Can someone draft the marketplace cutover timeline with exact publish times + embargo window in UTC? We need to coordinate cloud marketplaces + SI training.

Tom: I'll draft. Proposed high level:
- Wave A (controlled): H100 (4/12 15:00 UTC) + H200 images (same day 18:00 UTC) behind embargo until 4/15 10:00 UTC
- Wave B (scale): MI300 (4/26 16:00 UTC) + B200 burst pools (4/26 16:00 UTC)
- Wave C (partner onramp): Gaudi marketplace listing + SI docs (5/12 09:00 UTC)

Ravi: Routing snippet for canary fallback (for ops / infra):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: region == request.region and model.family == "h200"
    prefer: [h200-quantized, h200-fp16, h100-compat]
  - match: region == request.region and model.family == "mi300"
    prefer: [mi300-rt, mi300-quantized, fallback-cpu]
  - default: [fallback-cpu]
```

Hannah: +legal noted. Also add a column in the timeline for NDAed partner press windows and embargo lift.

Carlos: SI onboarding checklist (short):
- images: completed tags, sha256, sz
- docs: quickstart + perf notes + known-limits
- test harness: perf-cases (latency P95), cost model sample
- contact: SI-eng rotation schedule
Will push a doc link shortly.

Lina: @Tom can you also add a rollback trigger (metric-based) for 24h post-cutover in case perf regressions show up? e.g., error-rate > 2% or P95 latency +30%

Tom: Yep. Rollback rule: if model-specific P95 > baseline*1.3 for 30m or error_rate > 0.02 for 15m then autoswitch to previous image and open incident. I'll add to timeline.

launch-bot: Created calendar event "marketplace-cutover-waves" for 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC and invited Lina, Tom, Ravi, Hannah, Carlos.

Ravi: One more ops note — for customers on Dedicated, we need a mapping table for model variants that are binary-compatible across families (e.g., h100-compat -> h200 native). I'll start a spreadsheet and share.

Carlos: Sharing labs doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/labs/gpu-waves (draft) — includes slot times and image build runner commands.

Lina: Perfect. Next steps: Tom to publish timeline draft by EOD, Carlos to share SI checklist doc, Ravi to share routing mapping, Hannah to confirm embargo windows with legal. We'll reconvene in the calendar event. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Tom: on it.

Hannah: noted.

Carlos: uploading checklist now.
